name: DCE dynamic campaign RAF over Caucasus
summary: Dynamic Campaign Engine (DCE) campaign for the AV-8B in RAF service on the Caucasus map.
description: DCE campaign for the AV-8B. The `EN` folder goes into `Mods\aircraft\AV8BNA\Missions` in the DCS install folder, and a DCE mission-script mod must be enabled with OvGME (re-enable after each DCS update).
